headline: Haaland's brace sinks Brazil: Norway knocks Brazil out of World Cup
summary: Erling Haaland scores twice to end Brazil's 'Mission Hexa' dream as Norway advances to the quarter-finals.
details: Erling Haaland's two goals have eliminated Brazil from the World Cup round-of-16, ending their quest for a sixth title.
Brazil entered the match with several injury concerns, with stars Neymar and Raphinha starting on the bench.
Gabriel Martinelli replaced the injured Lucas Paqueta in the starting lineup, while 19-year-old Rayan featured in the attack.

headline: Cristiano Ronaldo announces his last World Cup
summary: The football legend signals the end of his journey with the Portuguese national team on the world's biggest stage.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced that the upcoming World Cup will be the final one of his illustrious career.
The Portuguese superstar, one of the most prolific goalscorers in football history, has signaled the end of his journey on the world's biggest stage.
This announcement marks a significant turning point for both the player and the Portugal national team as they prepare for the tournament.
Ronaldo's legacy includes numerous records and titles, making his departure from the World Cup a major event in global sports.
caption:
